## Install (macOS, Apple Silicon)

1. Download the `.dmg` below, open it, and drag **Simple PDF** into **Applications**.
2. Open Simple PDF. macOS will say it "cannot verify" the app, because it isn't signed with a paid Apple Developer ID. Click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to the Simple PDF message. Confirm with your password.

You only need to do this once. Full instructions and a Terminal alternative are in the [README](https://github.com/ddmiller1995/simple-pdf#installing).
